prompt: Your quiz score is $f(q) = 4q$ points, and the quiz has at most $10$ questions ($q$ can be $0$ to $10$). What is the LARGEST output in the range?
hint: The range is the set of possible outputs. Think about which input would produce the biggest one.

hints.text: The range is the set of possible outputs. Think about which input would produce the biggest one.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Check the ends: $q = 0$ gives $0$ points and $q = 10$ gives $40$ points. The range is everything the machine CAN output between those.
Multiplying by $4$ makes bigger inputs give bigger outputs, and the biggest allowed input is $q = 10$. Work out $f(10)$.
$f(10) = 4 \times 10 = 40$, so the largest output in the range is $40$ points.

explanation: The domain, or set of allowed inputs, runs from $q = 0$ up to $q = 10$.
The rule multiplies by a positive number, $4$, so a bigger input always gives a bigger output.
The largest output therefore comes from the largest input: $f(10) = 4 \times 10 = 40$ points.

alternativeExplanations.title: List the outputs
steps: The outputs are $0, 4, 8, 12, \ldots$ climbing by $4$ each time.
They stop when the questions run out at $q = 10$: the last one is $40$.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ Dodge the trap
steps: Answering 10 hands back the number of questions — the input — when the question wants the best possible SCORE.
Push the biggest allowed input through the machine: f(10) = 4 × 10 = 40 points.
